findings.title: Visibility Bug: Section Headings Invisible on Black Background
findings.description: Section headers (Pickup Games, Organised Sessions, Tournaments) use text-slate-950 (dark gray) on bg-black background, making them unreadable.
findings.fix: Change text-slate-950 to text-white and text-slate-600 to text-slate-400

codeSnippet.wrong:
Pickup Games

Free casual play. Jump in anytime.
codeSnippet.right:
Pickup Games

Free casual play. Jump in anytime.

findings.title: Ambiguous Design Intent – What Work Remains?
findings.description: Design document is written as instructional for new implementation ('Refactor existing...') but code already exists. Unclear whether this is documentation of completed work or specification of remaining tasks.
findings.fix: Clarify design intent: either (a) rename to 'Implementation Complete – Design Documentation' with verification checklist, or (b) explicitly list what is already done vs. remaining work
findings.impact: Unclear scope and handoff to developers

findings.title: Unclear Countdown Timer Edge Case Handling
findings.description: Countdown timer boundary at 24–72 hours is ambiguous. Design says '1–3 days' but implementation checks 'hours < 72'. Format for 1–24 hours differs slightly (design: 'XhYm' vs implementation: 'X h Y m').
findings.fix: Specify exact countdown display rules: '0–59m: Xm left (red, urgent) | 1–23h: XhYm (blue) | 24–71h: Xd left (blue) | 72+h: no countdown'

codeSnippet.clarification: Current implementation uses 'hours < 72' boundary; verify if this is intentional or should be 'hours < 24' for the 3-day cutoff

findings.title: Missing Loading State for Featured Carousel on Initial Page Load
findings.description: Featured carousel returns null when games list is empty during initial load, causing section to disappear and create visible jank. No skeleton placeholder is shown during ~1–3s 4G load time.
findings.fix: Add isLoading prop and render FeaturedCarouselSkeleton (3 skeleton cards) while loading. Pass pageLoading state to component.
findings.impact: Violates AC17 requirement of smooth load with no jank; poor user experience during 4G throttle

findings.title: Sort Dropdown Behavior Undefined Across Category Changes
findings.description: Design doesn't specify whether sort preference should persist when switching categories or reset to 'Upcoming'. Current implementation persists, which can lead to confusing UX (sorting 'Tournaments' by 'Most Popular' after switching from 'Pickup Games').
findings.location: Design section 4 (Category Navigation) and /app/games/page.js CategoryNav component
findings.fix: Clarify in design: 'Sort preference persists globally across all categories' OR 'Sort resets to Upcoming when changing categories'. Update implementation if needed.
findings.impact: Undefined UX behavior; risk of user confusion

findings.title: Animation Delay Applied Without Animation Class
findings.description: FeaturedCarousel cards apply animationDelay style but lack animate-fade-in-up class, so staggered entrance animation is ignored.
findings.fix: Add animate-fade-in-up class: <div className="premium-hover animate-fade-in-up" style={{ animationDelay: `${idx * 0.1}s` }}>

findings.title: Inconsistent Button Labels for Paid vs Free Games
findings.description: Paid games show '✓ Booked' when joined; free games show '✓ Joined'. Design doesn't clarify if labels should differ or be consistent.
findings.fix: Clarify design: 'Paid games show ✓ Booked (disabled) when payment verified. Free games show ✓ Joined with optional Leave button.' Or standardize to one label.
findings.impact: Minor visual inconsistency; not a functional issue

findings.title: Guest Checkout Modal Theme Mismatch
findings.description: Guest checkout modal uses generic dark theme (bg-slate-900) without premium lime accents or flourishes seen in hero/featured sections. Visual polish gap.
findings.fix: Optional: Add lime accent to modal title or form labels (e.g., border-b-2 border-lime-400 on title) to match premium theme aesthetic.
findings.impact: Visual polish only; not a blocker

findings.title: Design Document Title Claim 'Nike-Level' – Subjective Without Benchmarking
findings.description: Design is marketed as 'Nike-Level Premium Redesign' but provides no competitive analysis or Nike design pattern citations. Subjective claim without evidence.
findings.fix: Optional: Either remove subjective framing or add Nike design pattern citations (e.g., 'Inspired by Nike's Hero-Featured-Grid pattern').
findings.impact: Sets high expectations without clear success criteria; minor documentation issue
